Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effects on both Digimon activate, so you gain 2 memory.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area. If I play a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, can I activate the effects on both Digimon to gain a total of 2 memory?
Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When you play a Tamer with [Matt Ishida] in its name, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon is [Gabumon - Bond of Friendship], you may unsuspend it.
